fusions.name: Springing Anchor
fusions.desc: Casts a barbed link at an enemy up to 6 tiles away and springs you to it, dealing 12 damage and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Skipping Rope
fusions.desc: Whips a ring of links around you that deals 3 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, and you move 15% faster for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Slack Line
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 7 tiles away, and you move 20% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Hopscotch
fusions.desc: Each enemy you kill builds a stack on you, up to 4. The next ability you use spends them all: you move and attack 5% faster per stack, 18% in all at 4 stacks, for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
